## What changed

Describe the user-visible behavior and why the change is needed.

## Validation

List the commands, environments, and evidence used to validate the change.

## Risk checklist

- [ ] Tests cover the changed behavior or the reason they do not is documented.
- [ ] API and configuration changes are backward compatible, or the breaking change is documented.
- [ ] Security, RBAC, secret, network, and data-migration effects were reviewed.
- [ ] Helm values, generated manifests, OpenAPI, dashboards, and documentation are updated where applicable.
- [ ] Release-sensitive dependencies and actions remain pinned and reviewed.
- [ ] No credentials, customer data, generated binaries, or local agent/session artifacts are included.
